status: Source-backed journal data; not independently gameplay-verified
notes: 56 Sora and 22 Riku identities. Seven CP disputes resolved using independent remake guides; contrary wiki infobox values retained in source-conflicts.json.

records.name: White Mushroom
records.effect: Using a friend card restores HP.
records.acquisition: Create a White Room. Complete three requested Fire, Blizzard or Thunder casts on a mushroom, or use Warp to remove it. Finish the encounter with White Mushroom as the last defeated enemy for its card roll. Darkness-room multipliers do not apply.

records.name: Black Fungus
records.effect: Activates a randomly chosen enemy-card effect.
records.acquisition: Create a Black Room and defeat Black Fungus last. Strike it before entering battle to delay invulnerability; attack when vulnerable. Its card roll replaces the map-card reward. Darkness-room multipliers do not apply; no KH1 combo-finish condition is used.

records.name: Card Soldier

records.name: Ansem
records.effect: In Re:CoM, grants resistance to fire, ice and lightning only.
records.acquisition: Twilight Town · Bounty chest, after clearing Reverse/Rebirth and defeating Marluxia’s first form as Sora.
records.editionNote: Stocked-card concealment is the original CoM Link Mode effect, not an omitted player benefit in Re:CoM. Enemy Ansem’s own use is a separate mechanic.

records.name: Xemnas

records.acquisition: Wonderland · Room of Rewards, Days bonus chest. Complete the Days movie and its journal entries first.
